title: I need a card mini game

posts.author: DiogoAsgard
posts.body:
I'm developing a JRPG in RPG MAKER MV.
I need a card battle plugin for my RPG, similar to those in FF9 or FF8. However, it must work 100% with a controller or a computer keyboard. All the ones I found online require the use of a mouse and replace the battle system with the card system.
I would like a plugin that does not replace the current battle system and is something secondary, just like in FF8 and FF9, to allow collectible cards and the ability to play against NPCs around the world. And, of course, the player should not need to use the mouse to play the card battle game.
The card battle game would be an optional feature in the game, not something mandatory.
Can anyone help me with this?

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body: Moved to Plugin Requests. Game Mechanics Design is for debating if your game *should* have a card system, not in getting help making it.
